page: Google Cloud Platform e2-highcpu-2 is an x86_64 architecture instance belonging to the e2 server family. It features 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical Intel Xeon core with 2 threads per core, operating at a clock speed of 2.2 GHz. The instance is configured with 2.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

Benchmark evaluations place this instance in the lower tier of performance. The stress-ng single-core CPU test scored 1105.98, while the multi-core CPU test registered 1452.89. Memory bandwidth tests show 80.99 GB/sec for cached small blocks, dropping to 13.03 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. Geekbench results include a single-core score of 906.0 and a multi-core score of 1073.0, reflecting limited processing capacity. LLM inference with a small 135M model achieves 164.01 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 64.17 tokens/sec for text generation.

This instance offers a highly constrained hardware profile, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads that do not require substantial memory or high-performance computing. The lack of local storage and low memory capacity present clear tradeoffs, limiting its utility for database hosting or memory-intensive applications. Appropriate workloads are restricted to lightweight tasks such as basic static web serving, minor text processing, or simple background utility scripts.
description: Google Cloud Platform e2-highcpu-2 is an entry-level x86_64 instance from the e2 family, configured with 2 vCPUs and 2.0 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.2 GHz, it features 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators. Performance benchmarks indicate limited processing capabilities, with a Geekbench single-core score of 906.0 and a multi-core score of 1073.0. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, reaching 13.03 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. Given these hardware limitations, the e2-highcpu-2 represents a low-cost option for basic, non-resource-intensive operations. It is best suited for lightweight workloads such as static web serving, simple text processing, and basic utility tasks that do not require significant memory or high-performance compute resources.
